description: Revise a playbook the workspace already has. Pass only the fields that change — the others are carried over. A field you do pass REPLACES its whole value, and no previous version is kept, so read_playbook first and revise what comes back. Owners and admins only.

content.description: Markdown. Typically a section on when to use it, a section on how the document should be structured, and the plan Monnet should follow, one step per line as 'Owner — what they do'.

description.description: One sentence starting with 'Use for …'. This is what Monnet matches a request against, so it decides whether the playbook is ever loaded.

name.description: What the workflow is called, in the team's own words (e.g. 'Vendor security review').

playbook_id.description: The playbook's id, as returned by list_playbooks or create_playbook.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: edit_playbook
